A cantora assumirá o posto que era ocupado por Virginia Fonseca. Além de rainha de bateria, Anitta também participa da disputa como compositora de um dos sambas finalistas. A obra é assinada em parceria com Arlindinho, Igor Leal, Fred Camacho, Fabian Juarez e Diego Nicolau. Para o Carnaval de 2027, a Grande Rio levará à avenida o enredo “Sankofa Tabon – Os Retornados da Costa do Ouro e a Estrela Negra da Liberdade”, que aborda a trajetória de africanos escravizados que conquistaram a liberdade no Brasil e retornaram ao continente africano. item.title: Meet Everett Leigh, the teenage pianist using music to help foster children by generating $2M
item.description: At just sixteen, Everett Leigh shines as a gifted pianist who believes in giving back. He created EverEverest, a nonprofit dedicated to empowering foster and underserved youth through music. With over fifty organized benefit concerts under his belt, he has raised substantial funds to support these children. His inspiring efforts earned him the Barron Prize for Young Heroes, showcasing his commitment to balancing his piano career with meaningful philanthropy. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
